why_it_matters.text: A muscle relaxant for spasticity that works as an alpha-2 agonist, the same mechanism as clonidine.

description: A muscle relaxant for spasticity that works as an alpha-2 agonist, the same mechanism as clonidine. Tizanidine (C9H8ClN5S, 254 g/mol) is a muscle relaxant dispensed on prescription.
